Each program runs independently in a fresh bounded container on each input. Use ordinary safe builtins; no reflection. Type annotations are postponed. Keep each program within 8192 characters and 16384 UTF-8 bytes. Return code strings in hypotheses, without Markdown fences. Do not include task identifiers, reference solutions or other examples.
